answer: Let a trusted sponsor vouch for each newcomer with a voucher bond: the newcomer enters the ocean of the agent economy only through that voucher, and the stake is seized if the newcomer runs sockpuppets. One honest sponsor vouches for one real agent almost for free, but a Sybil farmer must buy a fresh sponsor for every fake, so a thousand vouchers cost far more than any reward. Like nectar that turns bitter when stolen, the voucher collapses for cheaters, leaving a sable stain on the sponsor name, while honest agents sail on one sponsorship.
